recipes.name: Banana and oat smoothie
recipes.method_note: Frozen banana makes it thick and cold without ice.

steps.instruction: Peel {{ing:banana-medium}}. Break into chunks.
Put the banana in a blender with {{ing:oats-rolled}} and {{ing:oat-milk}}.
Add {{ing:peanut-butter}} and {{ing:cinnamon-ground}}.
Blend for 1 minute, until smooth with no flecks of oat.
Pour into two glasses.

recipes.name: Berry and yoghurt smoothie
recipes.method_note: Frozen berries work as well as fresh and cost less.

steps.instruction: Put {{ing:strawberries}} and {{ing:blueberries}} in a blender.
Add {{ing:natural-yoghurt}}, {{ing:milk-semi-skimmed}} and {{ing:honey}}.
Blend for 1 minute, until smooth and pink all through.
Pour into two glasses.
steps.note: Too thick? Add a splash more milk and blend again.

recipes.name: Mango lassi
recipes.method_note: A ripe mango gives way when you press it gently.

steps.instruction: Cut the flesh from {{ing:mango}}. Throw away the stone and skin.
Put the mango in a blender with {{ing:natural-yoghurt}} and {{ing:milk-semi-skimmed}}.
Add {{ing:honey}} and {{ing:cinnamon-ground}}.
Blend for 1 minute, until smooth and pale orange.
Pour into two glasses.

recipes.name: Green morning smoothie
recipes.method_note: The spinach disappears into the fruit. You taste banana and apple.

steps.instruction: Peel {{ing:banana-medium}} and {{ing:kiwi}}.
Put them in a blender with {{ing:spinach}} and {{ing:apple-juice}}.
Squeeze in the juice from {{ing:lime}}.
Blend for 1 minute, until bright green with no leafy bits.
Pour into two glasses.

recipes.name: Golden turmeric milk
recipes.method_note: Warm, not boiling. Boiled milk forms a skin.

steps.instruction: Grate {{ing:ginger-fresh}} into a small pan.
Add {{ing:milk-semi-skimmed}}, {{ing:turmeric-ground}}, {{ing:cinnamon-ground}} and {{ing:black-pepper-ground}}.
Put on a low heat for 5 minutes, until steaming but not bubbling.
Whisk for 30 seconds, until frothy.
Stir in {{ing:honey}}. Pour into two mugs.
steps.note: Oat milk and maple syrup make it vegan.

recipes.name: Proper hot chocolate
recipes.method_note: Mixing the cocoa to a paste first stops lumps.

steps.instruction: Put {{ing:cocoa-powder}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}} in a small pan.
Add 3 tablespoons of the milk. Stir to a smooth paste.
Stir in the rest of {{ing:milk-whole}}.
Put on a low heat for 5 minutes, until steaming.
Break in {{ing:dark-chocolate}}. Stir until melted.
Stir in {{ing:vanilla-extract}}. Pour into two mugs.

recipes.name: Fresh mint tea
recipes.method_note: Leave the leaves whole. Torn leaves turn the tea bitter.

steps.instruction: Boil {{ing:water}} in a kettle.
Put {{ing:fresh-mint}} in a teapot or large jug.
Pour the boiling water over the mint.
Leave for 5 minutes, until pale green and fragrant.
Stir in {{ing:honey}}. Pour into two mugs with a slice of {{ing:lemon}}.
steps.note: Maple syrup instead of honey makes it vegan.

recipes.name: Ginger, lemon and honey
recipes.method_note: Good when you have a cold, or after a big meal.

steps.instruction: Slice {{ing:ginger-fresh}} thinly. No need to peel it.
Put the ginger in a small pan with {{ing:water}}.
Simmer (small bubbles) for 10 minutes, until the water tastes of ginger.
Squeeze in the juice from {{ing:lemon}}.
Stir in {{ing:honey}}. Pour through a sieve into two mugs.
